newsitem.title: USA: Centennial Tech redeems stake in unit.
newsitem.headline: Centennial Tech redeems stake in unit.

text.p: Centennial Technologies Inc said Tuesday it had completed the redemption of part of its stake in its contract manufacturing subsidiary, Century Electronics Manufacturing Inc.
It said the redemption reduced its stake in the subsidiary to 45 percent from 67 percent.
It said it also transferred to Century its majority interest in Centennial Technologies (Thailand) Ltd, and sold to Century previously leased equipment.
In the deals, Century paid Centennial $5.8 million in cash, a $1.9 million promissory note, and a $6 million subordinated convertible debenture, Centennial said.

It said its lender, First National Bank of Boston, has extended to July 31 a forebearance agreement on a credit line having a balance of $1.5 million. Negotiations continue with another lender, Congress Financial, for replacement borrowing facilities, which are expected to be in place in three weeks, it said.
Centennial said it has requested from the Securities and Exchange Commission an extension until July 15 to file its financial report for the year ended March 31.
